title: Golfpark Mieminger Plateau
highlights: 27-hole golf resort situated on Tyrol's sunniest alpine high plateau
18-hole Champion Course combined with a compact 9-hole Park Course
Unique golfing pleasure facing the dramatic rocky faces of the Mieminger Kette
Extended playing season from mid-March to late November thanks to the mild climate
kurzbeschreibung: Golfpark Mieminger Plateau impresses with its 27-hole facility on a sun-drenched plateau at the foot of the Mieminger Kette.
beschreibung:
Sun-Kissed First-Class Golf

Golfpark Mieminger Plateau is situated at around 880 metres above sea level on the expansive high plateau west of Innsbruck. Thanks to its sheltered south-facing aspect and countless sunny days each year, the golf park boasts one of the longest playing seasons in the entire Alps.

27 Holes for Every Skill Level

The spacious grounds feature the challenging 18-hole Championcourse as well as the quicker-to-play 9-hole Parkcourse. Framed by ancient larch and spruce forests, the fairways repeatedly open up spectacular views of the soaring rock faces of the Mieminger Kette and the Inntal.
